name: Sakura Maid 3
source:
Sena’s master has yet to return home, but another mysterious guest has appeared at her front doorstep. Supposedly hailing from the Iron Cliffs, Ladon is an ambassador of dragonkind, a species that has long thought to be little more than a myth. Ladon intially desires to speak with Sena’s master, but due to The Master’s absence, she chooses to wait for her at the manor instead.

The two of them gradually grow closer as they spend time together, eventually desiring each other’s company in a far more intimate way.

[From [url=https://denpasoft.com/shop/sakura-maid-3/?age-verified=dedb0a8a4f]DenpaSoft[/url]]
translation:
Sena的主人尚未归来，另一位神秘访客却出现在了宅邸门前。Ladon自称来自“铁崖”，是龙族的使者——长久以来，人们都以为这个种族只是传说。她原本想与Sena的主人交谈，但主人不在，于是决定留在宅邸等候。

两人在相处中渐渐亲近，最终渴望以更加亲密的方式陪伴彼此。
